messages:
maria: Hey devex — heads up, CI for ruby/sampleapp PR #2487 is failing only on the JRuby matrix. Bundler hangs trying to build the ffi native extension. Repro locally with `rvm jruby-9.3.4.0 && bundle install` — it stalls at `Installing ffi 1.16.1 with native extensions` :thinking: Anyone seen this? Link: <ci/2487>
rahul: I saw a similar flake last month — we pinned puma ext? Was that in Gemfile.lock?
tim: Quick check: can you paste the bundle output? sometimes `--local` helps if ext already built.
maria: Pasted log: ```Fetching ffi-1.16.1.gem
Installing ffi 1.16.1 with native extensions
rake aborted!
Errno::EACCES: Permission denied - /tmp/bundler...``` Looks like file perms in the container.
ci-bot: CI: ruby-sampleapp #2487 — job jruby-compat failed (exit code 1).
claire: We changed the Dockerfile for linux-musl to run as non-root recently. Might be that. If so, workaround is to set `BUNDLE_PATH` to a writable dir in CI and/or `gem install --user-install`.
maria: Tried `bundle config set --local path vendor/bundle` — still fails at ext compile step. Error shows `/usr/bin/gcc: not found`. So no compiler in image :facepalm:
sam: Ah that's it. musl images strip build tools. Options: add `BUILD_PACKAGES=\'build-base ruby-dev\'` or use a debian base for JRuby. For minimal change I'd add `apk add --no-cache build-base` in CI before bundle.
maria: Nice, adding that to .gitlab-ci.yml now. Will push a quick fix. Thanks!
rahul: :thumbsup: If okay, add a comment in PR about why image change and mark for backport to other sampleapps.
maria: Will do. Pushing fix in a sec. cc @devex for visibility.
